description: Losing the callee to a branch conditions every parameter the branch can reach — over-strict, never a lie — so the throwing argument is reported and the clean one discharges.

diagnostics.message: Call to `dispatch` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is non-throwing given `a`, and the argument passed for `a` is throwing — its body was analyzed and can throw. `dispatch` enters `a` at src/index.ts:4. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`, or pass something non-throwing for `a`.
